strategy: Extract frames, analyze shapes via pixel clustering, implement Revideo Rect morphing with iterative refinement
agent_behavior: Extracted all 481 frames and tracked 12 colored shapes using scipy ndimage label + color matching across every frame
Spent ~40 episodes on deep pixel analysis: radial scans, bbox tracking, rounded-rect fitting, ASCII mask visualization to reverse-engineer the morphing pattern
Correctly identified the circle-to-square morphing via Rect radius (radius=35 for circle, radius=0 for square) and row-staggered timing
Identified edge-anchoring behavior where corner/edge shapes grow asymmetrically toward the canvas interior
Implemented grow/shrink stages with position offsets to handle edge vs interior shape growth differences
Iteratively tuned timing parameters by comparing frame-by-frame sizes and errors over ~20 render+compare cycles
Tried multiple rendering parameters (resolutionScale 0.5, 1.0, 2.0) seeking marginal improvements
Final mean pixel error 3.91 vs baseline encoding noise of ~3.55 — within 10% of the theoretical minimum
